addressX.title: TextureAddress
addressX.description: The addressing mode to use for the X axis.

addressY.title: TextureAddress
addressY.description: The addressing mode to use for the Y axis.

assetImportData.title: /Script/Engine.AssetImportData
assetImportData.description: Represents a reference to a UObject or UClass.

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

adjustBrightness.description: Static texture brightness adjustment (scales HSV value.)  (Non-destructive; Requires texture source art to be available.)

adjustBrightnessCurve.description: Static texture curve adjustment (raises HSV value to the specified power.)  (Non-destructive; Requires texture source art to be available.)

adjustVibrance.description: Static texture "vibrance" adjustment (0 - 1) (HSV saturation algorithm adjustment.)  (Non-destructive; Requires texture source art to be available.)

adjustSaturation.description: Static texture saturation adjustment (scales HSV saturation.)  (Non-destructive; Requires texture source art to be available.)

adjustRGBCurve.description: Static texture RGB curve adjustment (raises linear-space RGB color to the specified power.)  (Non-destructive; Requires texture source art to be available.)

adjustHue.description: Static texture hue adjustment (0 - 360) (offsets HSV hue by value in degrees.)  (Non-destructive; Requires texture source art to be available.)

adjustMinAlpha.description: Remaps the alpha to the specified min/max range, defines the new value of 0 (Non-destructive; Requires texture source art to be available.)

adjustMaxAlpha.description: Remaps the alpha to the specified min/max range, defines the new value of 1 (Non-destructive; Requires texture source art to be available.)

compressionNoAlpha.description: If enabled, the texture's alpha channel will be forced to opaque for any compressed texture output format.  Does not apply if output format is uncompressed RGBA.

compressFinal.description: If enabled, compress with Final quality during this Editor session.

deferCompression.description: If enabled, defer compression of the texture until save or manually compressed in the texture editor.

lossyCompressionAmount.title: ETextureLossyCompressionAmount
lossyCompressionAmount.description:
How aggressively should any relevant lossy compression be applied. For compressors that support EncodeSpeed (i.e. Oodle), this is only
     applied if enabled (see Project Settings -> Texture Encoding). Note that this is *in addition* to any
     unavoidable loss due to the target format - selecting "No Lossy Compression" will not result in zero distortion for BCn formats.

oodleTextureSdkVersion.description: Oodle Texture SDK Version to encode with.  Enter 'latest' to update; 'None' preserves legacy encoding to avoid patches.

maxTextureSize.description: The maximum resolution for generated textures. A value of 0 means the maximum size for the format on each platform.

compressionQuality.title: ETextureCompressionQuality
compressionQuality.description: The compression quality for generated ASTC textures (i.e. mobile platform textures).

compressionCacheId.description: Change this optional ID to force the texture to be recompressed by changing its cache key.

bDoScaleMipsForAlphaCoverage.description: Whether mip RGBA should be scaled to preserve the number of pixels with Value >= AlphaCoverageThresholds.  AlphaCoverageThresholds are ignored if this is off.

alphaCoverageThresholds.title: Vector4
alphaCoverageThresholds.description: Alpha values per channel to compare to when preserving alpha coverage. 0 means disable channel.  Typical good values in 0.5 - 0.9, not 1.0

bUseNewMipFilter.description: Disable for legacy compatibility.  New and changed textures should set this to use modern improved image processing.

bPreserveBorder.description: When true the texture's border will be preserved during mipmap generation.

bFlipGreenChannel.description: When true the texture's green channel will be inverted. This is useful for some normal maps.

powerOfTwoMode.title: ETexturePowerOfTwoSetting
powerOfTwoMode.description: How to pad the texture to a power of 2 size (if necessary)

paddingColor.title: LinearColor
paddingColor.description: The color used to pad the texture out if it is padded due to PowerOfTwoMode

bPadWithBorderColor.description: If set to true, texture padding will be performed using colors of the border pixels. This can be used to improve quality of the generated mipmaps for padded textures.

resizeDuringBuildX.description: Width of the resized texture when using "Resize To Specific Resolution" padding and resizing option. If set to zero, original width will be used.

resizeDuringBuildY.description: Width of the resized texture when using "Resize To Specific Resolution" padding and resizing option. If set to zero, original height will be used.

bChromaKeyTexture.description: Whether to chroma key the image, replacing any pixels that match ChromaKeyColor with transparent black

chromaKeyThreshold.description: The threshold that components have to match for the texel to be considered equal to the ChromaKeyColor when chroma keying (<=, set to 0 to require a perfect exact match)

chromaKeyColor.title: LinearColor
chromaKeyColor.description: The color that will be replaced with transparent black if chroma keying is enabled

mipGenSettings.title: TextureMipGenSettings
mipGenSettings.description: Per asset specific setting to define the mip-map generation properties like sharpening and kernel size.

compositeTexture.title: /Script/Engine.Texture
compositeTexture.description: Represents a reference to a UObject or UClass.

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

compositeTextureMode.title: ECompositeTextureMode
compositeTextureMode.description: defines how the CompositeTexture is applied, e.g. CTM_RoughnessFromNormalAlpha

compositePower.description:
default 1, high values result in a stronger effect e.g 1, 2, 4, 8
this is not a slider because the texture update would not be fast enough

lODBias.description: A bias to the index of the top mip level to use.  That is, number of mip levels to drop when cooking.

compressionSettings.title: TextureCompressionSettings
compressionSettings.description: Compression settings to use when building the texture.

filter.title: TextureFilter
filter.description: The texture filtering mode to use when sampling this texture.

virtualTextureStreamingPriority.title: EVTProducerPriority
virtualTextureStreamingPriority.description: Priority to use when using virtual texture streaming for this texture.

virtualTexturePrefetchMips.description:
The number of mips that a virtual texture can stream using the traditional CPU texture streaming system.
In most cases this should be 0 because the virtual texture GPU feedback is sufficient and will minimize memory usage.
But CPU prefetching can be used in some cases to avoid late appearance of mips.

cookPlatformTilingSettings.title: TextureCookPlatformTilingSettings
cookPlatformTilingSettings.description: If the platform supports it, tile the texture when cooking, or keep it linear and tile it when it's actually submitted to the GPU.

bOodlePreserveExtremes.description: If set to true, then Oodle encoder preserves 0 and 255 (0.0 and 1.0) values exactly in alpha channel for BC3/BC7 and in all channels for BC4/BC5.

lODGroup.title: TextureGroup
lODGroup.description: Texture group this texture belongs to

downscale.title: PerPlatformFloat
downscale.description:
Downscale source texture, applied only to 2d textures without mips
< 1.0 - use scale value from texture group
1.0 - do not scale texture
> 1.0 - scale texure

availability.title: ETextureAvailability
availability.description:
Whether the texture will be encoded to a gpu format and uploaded to the graphics card, or kept on the CPU for access by gamecode / blueprint.
For CPU availability, the texture will still upload a tiny black texture as a placeholder. Only applies to 2d textures.

sRGB.description: Whether Texture and its source are in SRGB Gamma color space.  Can only be used with 8-bit and compressed formats.  This should be unchecked if using alpha channels individually as masks.

bNormalizeNormals.description: Normalize colors in Normal Maps after mip generation for better and sharper quality; recommended on if not required to match legacy behavior.

bUseLegacyGamma.description: A flag for using the simplified legacy gamma space e.g pow(color,1/2.2) for converting from FColor to FLinearColor, if we're doing sRGB.

sourceColorSettings.title: TextureSourceColorSettings
sourceColorSettings.description: Texture color management settings: source encoding and color space.

encodingOverride.title: ETextureSourceEncoding
encodingOverride.description: Source encoding of the texture, exposing more options than just sRGB.

colorSpace.title: ETextureColorSpace
colorSpace.description: Source color space of the texture.

redChromaticityCoordinate.title: Vector2D
redChromaticityCoordinate.description: Red chromaticity coordinate of the source color space.

greenChromaticityCoordinate.title: Vector2D
greenChromaticityCoordinate.description: Green chromaticity coordinate of the source color space.

blueChromaticityCoordinate.title: Vector2D
blueChromaticityCoordinate.description: Blue chromaticity coordinate of the source color space.

whiteChromaticityCoordinate.title: Vector2D
whiteChromaticityCoordinate.description: White chromaticity coordinate of the source color space.

chromaticAdaptationMethod.title: ETextureChromaticAdaptationMethod
chromaticAdaptationMethod.description: Chromatic adaption method applied if the source white point differs from the working color space white point.

virtualTextureStreaming.description: Is this texture streamed in using VT

bUseVirtualTextureStreamingPriority.description: Override the virtual texture streaming priority set on this texture by the texture LOD group.

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

assetUserData.description: Array of user data stored with the asset

numCinematicMipLevels.description: Number of mip-levels to use for cinematic quality.

bGlobalForceMipLevelsToBeResident.description: Global and serialized version of ForceMiplevelsToBeResident.
